canonical_definition: 목적지 공식 통계가 정의한 inbound visitor/arrival count
comparison_rule: 동일 출발시장 정의와 동일 기간에서 비교
forbidden_substitution: immigration entries or border movements cannot replace tourism visitors without crosswalk

canonical_definition: 공식 목적구분 중 leisure/tourism에 해당하는 방문
forbidden_substitution: total arrivals cannot stand in for tourism-purpose arrivals
hotel nights cannot automatically replace visitor stay length
visitor arrivals cannot be multiplied by average stay when source populations differ
card spend cannot replace total tourism expenditure
survey spend divided by administrative arrivals without compatibility check

canonical_definition: 방문자가 목적지 내 지역/도도부현/도시를 방문한 관측
forbidden_substitution: regional visit counts cannot be summed as unique visitors
search volume cannot substitute survey-reported information source
OTA listing availability cannot stand in for booking share
card network transaction share cannot be equated to traveler payment preference
review rating cannot directly replace official survey satisfaction
intention cannot replace observed repeat visitation
registered rooms cannot replace sellable inventory
destination-wide tourism demand cannot be inferred from occupancy alone
nationality and residence must never be silently merged
broken series cannot be treated as homogeneous trend
